text: 37 I had a little seed And I put it in a pot I put it in the sunshine, And cared for it a lot. I waited and waited, I watched it grow and grow, And then one day a flower, Peeped out and said Hello! 1. Listen and repeat. 2. Read and write. seed grow sunshine cared waited watched 3. Look at the pictures and number them in proper sequence. 4. Activity : Sow seeds in a pot and observe them everyday. My Flower 2.11 -Margaret Schrodr For the Teacher : • Encourage the children to ask questions about the growth of a plant.
